caption: The drawing shows a single wooden vessel with an elongated, curved body and a large handle attached to its left side. The main body of the vessel is reddish-brown, while the interior is a lighter, tan shade with subtle wood grain texture visible. The vessel has an asymmetrical form with a broad, rounded base tapering toward a narrower, slightly upturned spout at the right end. The handle is rectangular in shape and merges smoothly with the main body. Around the centrally-featured vessel are four smaller, outlined diagrams—one above, one below, and two on each side—showing the object from different perspectives, including profiles and a top-down view. The entire composition is set against a pale, uncolored background.
title: Wooden Meal Scoop
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
